D/ [CONST]ANTI NVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLOR[IA EXERCITVS]

: Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: [CONST]ANTI NVS MAX AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR[IA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: TRP.
